title: Schedule
body: Browse church events you can see based on public and ministry visibility.
emptyState: No events to show for this church yet.

removeDialog.body: This voids the volunteer's commitment on this roster. They are not notified automatically.

edit.heading: Edit event

unavailabilityOffer.body: Optional: record unavailability for the same UTC window you just released ({{start}} → {{end}}). Nothing is saved until you confirm.
unavailabilityOffer.success: Unavailability recorded for this ministry and time window.
